responsibility: Implements PHI-based CFG simplifications and conditional-store elimination on SSA GIMPLE. It matches diamond and if/then/else patterns around PHIs to replace them with straight-line assignments such as conditional replacement, value propagation, ABS/MIN/MAX and related forms, factors conversions out of conditional expressions, can hoist adjacent loads for conditional-move formation, and also performs conditional store elimination by turning branchy stores into unified post-diamond stores when memory-safety constraints allow it.
